payout_quote: Get $500* when you open a new Business Checking Account. The bonus will be deposited within 30 days of meeting requirements, if the account remains open with a positive balance.
timing: $500 bonus deposited within 30 days of meeting requirements, if the account remains open with a positive balance.
biggest_catch: Requires parking $5,000 of new money in the account: deposit at least $5,000 within 30 days and maintain at least $5,000 through the 60th day. Business checking only — opened in person, by phone, or via appointment request.
eligibility: New business checking customers: one bonus per business entity. Not valid if you or any signer owned a Security National Bank Business Checking account within the last 24 months. Iowa/South Dakota (Siouxland branches).
catches: Offer expires on 12/31/26 and may be withdrawn at any time.
Minimum $5,000 of deposits within 30 days of account opening; thereafter maintain at least $5,000 until the 60th day after account opening.
New money only — funding must come from outside Security National Bank or an affiliate.
The bonus will be deposited within 30 days of meeting requirements, if the account remains open with a positive balance.
One Business Checking bonus per business entity; not valid with other Business Checking bonus offers.
Not valid if you or any signer on the account has owned a Business Checking Account within the last 24 months at Security National Bank.
Bank bonuses are generally reportable as taxable income; the official offer page shows no tax language, so confirm treatment with a tax advisor.
Claim by requesting an appointment via the online form, calling (712) 277-6500, or visiting a branch in person.
steps: Confirm your business is eligible: new business checking, and no signer has owned an SNB Business Checking account in the last 24 months.
Request an appointment via the online form on the offer page, call (712) 277-6500, or visit a branch in Iowa/South Dakota in person.
Open the new Business Checking account.
Deposit at least $5,000 of new money (from outside Security National Bank or an affiliate) within 30 days of account opening.
Maintain a balance of at least $5,000 through the 60th day after account opening.
The $500 bonus is deposited within 30 days of meeting requirements, provided the account remains open with a positive balance.
